results.text: Which sellers have never had a dispute raised against their orders?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name
FROM sellers s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    JOIN disputes d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
    WHERE o.seller_id = s.seller_id
)
LIMIT 1000
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name FROM sellers s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN disputes d ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.seller_id = s.seller_id) ORDER BY s.seller_id

results.text: What is the total order value per logistics provider?
results.generated_sql: SELECT lp.provider_id, lp.display_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM logistics_providers lp JOIN fulfillments f ON lp.provider_id = f.provider_id JOIN orders o ON f.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY lp.provider_id, lp.display_name LIMIT 1000
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT lp.provider_id, lp.display_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM logistics_providers lp JOIN fulfillments f ON f.provider_id = lp.provider_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id GROUP BY lp.provider_id, lp.display_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC

results.text: Which cities have both a seller and a logistics provider hub located in them?
results.category: right values but WRONG ROW COUNT (missing aggregation/filter)
results.generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT l1.city
FROM locations l1
JOIN sellers s ON l1.location_id = s.location_id
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT l2.city
FROM locations l2
JOIN logistics_providers lp ON l2.location_id = lp.hub_location_id
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.city FROM locations l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sellers s WHERE s.location_id = l.location_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_providers lp WHERE lp.hub_location_id = l.location_id) ORDER BY l.city

results.text: What is the average order value for B2B orders versus B2C orders?

results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_channel, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY order_channel ORDER BY order_channel

results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ci.item_id) AS distinct_items FROM sellers s JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.display_name ORDER BY distinct_items DESC LIMIT 3

results.text: What percentage of fulfillments were delivered after their promised time?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.delivered_at > f.promised_at THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(f.fulfillment_id), 0),
        2
    ) AS delayed_percentage
FROM fulfillments f
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at > promised_at) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS pct_late FROM fulfillments

results.text: Which buyer apps have placed orders totalling more than 10000 in value?

results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT np.participant_id, np.legal_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_value FROM network_participants np JOIN orders o ON o.buyer_app_id = np.participant_id GROUP BY np.participant_id, np.legal_name HAVING SUM(o.order_value) > 10000 ORDER BY total_value DESC

results.text: List the 5 most recent disputes along with the seller name on the related order.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.dispute_id,
    d.order_id,
    d.raised_at,
    d.category,
    s.display_name AS seller_name
FROM disputes d
JOIN orders o ON d.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id
ORDER BY d.raised_at DESC
LIMIT 5
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.dispute_id, d.raised_at, s.display_name FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = d.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = o.seller_id ORDER BY d.raised_at DESC LIMIT 5
